classification: EXPLORATORY retrospective historical review; not deployment approval
economic_hypothesis: The previous 50 complete 30-minute highs/lows can trigger short-horizon continuation with positive average net PnL after the specified illustrative per-side costs.
falsifier: Cost-aware average net PnL per closed trade is not positive, or the native fills violate the trigger, protective stop, next-boundary exit, or daily entry cap.

instrument.identity_limit: Not a verified CME E-mini Nasdaq-100 futures contract. One illustrative NQ-equivalent contract maps $20 per point; no CFD contract specifications are asserted.

data.timestamp_source: Dukascopy .bi5 seconds-from-UTC-midnight decoder; stored naive timestamp interpreted as UTC
data.calendar: dukascopy-us-index-trading-break-calendar-v2; only complete source 30-minute bars and bars with the required next opening print qualify

rules.bar_size: 30 minutes aligned to 17:00 America/Chicago session start
rules.lookback: highest high / lowest low of previous 50 complete 30-minute bars
rules.entry: one native buy STOP at prior high and one native sell STOP at prior low; cancel other order after first fill
rules.entry_trigger_source: 1-minute source OHLC through native NEXT_BAR STOP orders
rules.protective_stop: $1,000 adverse per one illustrative NQ-equivalent contract; $50.00 index points from entry
rules.exit: market order at opening print of immediately following 30-minute bar
rules.daily_limit: maximum 2 filled entries per Chicago Globex session date
rules.grid_mapping: Round stop prices to nearest $0.25 NQ-equivalent grid point; preserve proxy prices otherwise. CFD quote grid is not verified as CME tick-conforming.
rules.same_minute_stop: Retain and flag cases where entry candle also reaches the protective stop; OHLC has no intraminute ordering.
